headline: PROP ticker PF jumps 25% intraday, topping today’s gainers.
market_take: Food and Property stocks led the market with multiple double‑digit moves, while Consumer Materials showed solid upside. Earnings releases from WGE (CONS), KPNREIT (PFREIT), PRIN and SIRI (PROP) and JDF (FOOD) provide fresh fundamentals. Unusual‑trading alerts across Food, PROP and CONMAT highlight heightened volatility and volume spikes.

sector_notes.note: XBIO (+14.29%) and MADAME (+10.87%) posted strong intraday gains; AQUA showed a +10% open gap then a -9.09% intraday swing, and CHOTI opened with a -100% gap, indicating volatility. Volume spikes were seen in PB (4σ) and CHAO (11.5σ).

PF surged +25% intraday, while A fell -7.25% amid an extreme 118.2σ volume spike. RML added +11.11%, JCK dropped -7.69%, and UV/ SPALI posted modest gains. PRIN and SIRI released Q2 earnings, and A5 announced cancellation of its second share‑repurchase program.
TASCO (+10.20%) and WIIK (+7.14%) led gains; GEL opened down -20% but rebounded +25% intraday, flagging sharp price swings.
SRICHA (+6.42%) was the top mover; TRITN displayed a +50% open gap followed by a -33.33% intraday drop, while APCS and SQ posted negative gaps. WGE filed its Q2 earnings.
TTLPF slipped -5.11%; KPNREIT released Q2 results. TU‑PF and MNIT2 each recorded a -100% open gap, and M‑PAT showed a -100% gap, underscoring sector stress.
